##### Project general facts

SHA Residence Emirates by IMKAN Properties is a pioneering wellness-focused residential development located on SHA Island at AlJurf, created in collaboration with the world-renowned SHA Wellness Clinic. Designed as the first fully integrated healthy living island, the project redefines luxury through a holistic approach where every architectural and spatial decision is centered on health, longevity, and balance. The residences are thoughtfully integrated into the natural landscape, with architecture that embraces the coastline, maximizes sea views, and enhances natural ventilation through carefully oriented layouts.

The lifestyle at SHA Residence is built around complete well-being and restoration. Residents benefit from seamless access to SHA Wellness Clinic facilities and a curated ecosystem dedicated to physical, mental, and emotional health. The island environment offers exceptional privacy and tranquility, with wellness programs, therapeutic spaces, and nature-driven experiences that encourage mindfulness and recovery. Every element of the community is designed to support a slower, healthier rhythm of life, far from urban stress, while remaining fully immersive and highly exclusive.

Interiors are finished with premium natural materials including marble, native woods, natural fibres, and artisanal details that reflect the surrounding environment. Spacious layouts emphasize openness, natural light, and a strong connection between indoor and outdoor living, with generous terraces framing serene waterfront views. The residences are fully furnished with a carefully selected package, ensuring a complete and harmonious living environment that aligns with the wellness philosophy of the project.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jurf is built in the UAE’s ancestors’ vision for the nation, a tranquil sanctuary that is seamlessly integrated with its natural environment. It is where residents can escape city life and instead live inside a natural masterpiece dedicated to the preservation of life and the generation of legacy.

Here, you’ll discover a world of natural beauty that includes lush gardens, pristine beaches, and a breathtaking coastline. With its own stretch of white sand beach, SHA Emirates sits across from the Al Jurf – amidst thousands of planted trees that form a verdant forest so guests will always be immersed in widely spread nature. Al Jurf is committed to sustainability, and its respect for the environment aligns perfectly with SHA Wellness Clinic’s philosophy, emphasising the importance of preserving the natural environment and fostering a harmonious relationship between humans and nature

Live in an oasis of nature and health, an unrepeatable gem, near with Abu Dhabi and Dubai, with an infinite offer of leisure, sports, entertainment, culture, shopping, or business. Al Jurf is your haven for a comprehensive well-being experience where wellness, leisure, and cultural heritage connect seamlessly. It is a unique destination that invites you to enjoy extraordinary surroundings in a tranquil lifestyle that honours nature and tradition, with wellness in mind.
